explanation_short: KNN outperforms other models with an R2 score of 0.817 and lowest MSE of 0.0128.
explanation_full: The KNN model achieved the highest R2 score (0.817) and the lowest Mean Squared Error (MSE) of 0.0128 among all tested models, indicating superior performance in predicting hydrogen production (HPR).  While RF and XGBoost also demonstrate strong performance with R2 scores above 0.7, KNN's lower MSE suggests greater accuracy in capturing the relationship between input features and HPR.
